name: frontend
description: Local-first workstation for running self-hosted LLMs
author: Sybil Solutions

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n NEXT,AGENT -c cyan,green "next dev" "bun run --cwd ../services/agent-runtime dev"
scripts.build: node ../scripts/project.mjs prepare-next && bun run --cwd ../services/agent-runtime bundle && next build --webpack && node ../scripts/project.mjs complete-standalone && node ../scripts/project.mjs assert-standalone
scripts.lint:oxlint: cd .. && node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --config frontend/.oxlintrc.json frontend/src frontend/desktop controller/src controller/contracts services/agent-runtime/src shared scripts
scripts.check:cleanup: bun run check:deadcode && bun run check:dupes && bun run depcheck
scripts.desktop:build:main: tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun build desktop/main.ts desktop/preload.ts --outdir desktop/dist --target=node --format=cjs --minify --external electron --external @lydell/node-pty
scripts.desktop:build: bun run build && bun run desktop:build:main
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run desktop:build:main && concurrently -k -n CONTROLLER,NEXT,ELECTRON -c yellow,cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd ../controller dev" "LOCAL_STUDIO_DESKTOP=1 bun run dev" "node -e \"setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000)\" && bun run desktop:start:dev"
scripts.desktop:dist:dev: bun run desktop:build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --config.appId=org.local.studio.desktop.dev --config.productName="Local Studio Dev" --config.extraMetadata.localStudioChannel=dev --config.directories.output=dist-desktop-dev
scripts.check:static: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:desktop && bun run typecheck:extensions && bun run check:cycles && bun run check:ui-structure
scripts.check:quality: node ../scripts/project.mjs validate-package && bun run check:static && bun run check:cleanup && bun run build
